favourite.heading: Why Massachusetts can pull away

underdog.heading: Why Eastern Michigan can keep it close
bullets: Stylistically the matchup favours Eastern Michigan by 0.4 points: field position (-0.4 pts).
The outcome range is 14.8 points wide at one sigma — p10 -13.0 to p90 +29.0 for Massachusetts, so a projection of +9.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 1%.

The market disagrees by 4.5 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
